name: Chengdu Gas Group Corporation Ltd.
summary: Chengdu Gas Group Corporation Ltd. engages in the transmission, distribution, and sale of urban gas in China. The company is involved in the supply of urban gas; urban gas engineering construction; pipeline installation; fire protection facility engineering construction; supply of gas-specific equipment and materials; flow meter calibration; gas appliance testing; urban gas pressure vessel testing; intelligent instruments and meters; research and development, production, sales, technology transfer, and services of computer software and hardware; technical services and consulting for electronic products; and other industrial investments. The company was formerly known as Chengdu Gas Company. …
